messages:
alexa: Hey all 11 new hires asked about the main orientation tomorrow 10: is the recording auto-uploaded or do we need to request it? Also timezone confusion: the invite shows 17:00 but my calendar turned it into 02:00 local (Melbourne) 1
onboarding-bot: Orientation event created: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=orient-2024-main. Recording will be available on the event page and on the onboarding Drive folder after the session.
ben: Hi @alexa 1 quick notes: 1) we upload the raw recording and a trimmed version (chapters + captions) to Drive under /onboarding/recordings; 2) if your calendar is shifting times Outlook/Apple often treat .ics as floating. Workaround: open the calendar link and add ?ctz=Australia/Melbourne to force the timezone when adding.
linda: Ben 1 thanks. Can we also get a transcript? Some hires asked for searchable text.
harry: Yes 1 we run the recording through the transcript pipeline and paste the text into the Notion orientation page: https://redwood.notion.so/onboarding/orientation. We also save SRT captions for accessibility.
alexa: Nice. For folks who can't attend live, is there an office-hours drop-in or a short catch-up walkthrough? Some in APAC are on odd hours.
ben: We schedule a shorter live replay for APAC Saturdays (30 mins + Q&A) and a weekly drop-in on Mondays at 17:00 UTC. I already created an APAC event: https://meet.google.com/apac-orient and invited new-hires@redwood.com.
linda: One small bug: when I added the invite to my corporate calendar it created a duplicate event (one with proper timezone, one at UTC) 1 any admin settings to avoid that?
harry: That happens if you accept both the Google invite and the forwarded .ics. Best is to accept from the calendar event page only. I'm going to update the event description with a bold note: "Do NOT import separate .ics if you've accepted via Google invite" and add explicit UTC/host timezone lines.
onboarding-bot: (automated) Updated calendar description for orient-2024-main with timezone table and links to APAC replay and Drive folder.
alexa: Will the slides be posted ahead of time? I want to skim the infra/security parts so I can ask relevant questions.
ben: Yep 1 decks are up: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/Onboard-Decks-2024. Also added a quick timestamp guide in the calendar description - shows conversions for PT/ET/CET/AEST.
linda: Any chance of enabling live captions in Mandarin? A couple of folks requested it for the EMEA session.
harry: We're enabling auto-captions in English for the main run and will attach translated captions where auto-translate quality is acceptable. If it's critical, please DM me the names and we'll coordinate a translator.
alexa: Thanks everyone 1 last thing: I hit a calendar conflict so I won't make the live slot. I'll watch the trimmed recording and join the Monday drop-in. :thumbsup:
ben: Great, noted. If anyone still sees timezone problems, DM me the event link and your local TZ and I can produce a TZ-fixed .ics.
